2609.28471.title: Contrastive Learning for Authorship Verification
2609.28471.paper_summary: Our results show that contrastive learning outperforms a classification-based approach to authorship verification under the tested settings. We identify loss function, batch size, training duration, pre-trained model, input context length, and random text span data augmentation as important factors of model performance. Based on these considerations, we develop a ModernBERT Bi-Encoder model that achieves 98.4% accuracy on the PAN21 authorship verification task.
2609.28471.paper_summary_zh: 我們的結果顯示，在測試的設定下，對比學習的表現優於基於分類的方法進行作者驗證。我們確定損失函數、批次大小、訓練時長、預訓練模型、輸入上下文長度和隨機文本跨度數據增強是模型性能的重要因素。基於這些考量，我們開發了一個 ModernBERT 雙編碼器模型，在 PAN21 作者驗證任務中達到了 98.4% 的準確率。
